title: Safety of Intravenous Milrinone for the Treatment of Subarachnoid Hemorrhage-induced Vasospasm
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to evaluate the tolerance of intravenous milrinone combined to the current standard treatment for cerebral vasospasm following subarachnoid hemorrhage. Assessment of IV milrinone safety in this setting is mandatory before the conduction of a large study assessing its effectiveness.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects 18 years
* Hospitalized in our intensive care unit
* Subarachnoid hemorrhage proven on CT angiogram
* Cerebral vasospasm proven on CT angiogram

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women
* Minor
* Major under guardianship
